name: sprint32_breakout_tail_liquidity_altbasket
hypothesis: Breakout FAILED on majors (sprint01, T2) and liquid alts (sprint18, T2). Momentum/breakout literature (Liu-Tsyvinski et al., cited sprint18/26) predicts effects concentrate in smaller, less-liquid, higher-turnover names where information diffuses slower. sprint26/31 already opened this tail-liquidity/delisted basket for volspike_drift and meanrev (both FAIL well-powered); breakout is the last untested signal in the 5-signal x 3-liquidity-regime coverage matrix.
power_argument: C0/C1 calibration: net_bps dispersion ~33bp std, T2 round-trip cost floor ~26bp -> min detectable edge at n=300, t=2 is ~2*33/sqrt(300)=3.8bp, well below the cost floor. sprint26 and sprint31 realized 4413 and 4323 validation trades respectively on this identical 8-symbol basket at cap8/day over the same ~92-day window; breakout's trigger is sparser than volspike/meanrev (sprint01 majors realized 1801 on 2 symbols, sprint18 alts realized 5866 on 8 symbols), so scaling sprint18's alt rate to this basket conservatively projects >=2000 trades, clearing the 300 floor with wide margin.
